title: Work within spend controls and procurement
summary: Public bodies often need approval to spend money on technology and must buy through set routes. Plan for this early.

beginner: Find out which spend approvals apply and their thresholds.
Find out how your organisation buys technology and services.
Build approval and procurement time into the plan.
Prepare the information approvers will need.
Ask colleagues who have done it before.

pitfalls: Locking into long contracts too early

leaderView.good: Spend approvals and procurement routes are planned early, with realistic lead times.
ask: Which approvals and buying routes do we need, and how long will they take?
What happens to the plan if approval is late?
signs: Delivery dates ignore approval lead times.
Procurement is treated as someone else's problem.
